title: Independence Realty Trust Reports Q3 2026 EPS of $0.11
summary: Independence Realty Trust reported Q3 2026 EPS of $0.11 versus $0.03 a year earlier and Core FFO per share of $0.29, and kept its CFFO guidance.
body_markdown:
In the same-store portfolio of 109 properties with 31,735 units, rental and other property revenue increased 2.0% and property operating expenses increased 2.5% from a year earlier, while net operating income (NOI) increased 1.6%. Average occupancy was 95.0%, a 40 basis point decrease, and the average rental rate rose 0.6% to $1,605. "Leasing momentum continued to build during the quarter," said Scott Schaeffer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, adding that new lease trade-outs improved 310 basis points year over year.


For full-year 2026, the company updated its EPS guidance to $0.18 to $0.20 from $0.22 to $0.27 and kept its CFFO per share guidance at $1.13 to $1.15. It said it reaffirmed the mid-points of its guidance for same-store revenues, same-store NOI and Core FFO per share. Other than merger and integration costs incurred through September 30, 2026, the guidance does not give effect to the Centerspace merger, the company said.


## Why It Matters for IRT


The results come as IRT works toward its pending merger with Centerspace, which the company said is expected to create an $8 billion multifamily REIT with 163 apartment communities and approximately 44,400 units across 17 states. Centerspace shareholders will receive 3.800 IRT shares for each Centerspace common share. The deal is expected to close as early as the end of the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to approval by both companies' shareholders on November 10, 2026. Based on $24 million in annual synergies it expects to realize, IRT said the transaction should be 5% accretive to CFFO.
